heroHeadline: Movement widens beyond exam halls: Jamia suspends 4 protesters over admissions row, NLSIU cancels convocation in CJI Surya Kant standoff
heroSubtitle: As the CJP's September 5 return march to Delhi Police headquarters looms with no new movement since Delhi Police's Aug 26 refusal, two fresh institutional-trust flashpoints emerged: Jamia Millia Islamia suspended and barred four NSUI-affiliated students on Aug 26 after a sit-in alleging spot-admission irregularities, while a student-and-alumni revolt over Chief Justice Surya Kant's planned attendance at law-school convocations forced NLSIU Bengaluru to cancel its Sep 12 ceremony outright on Aug 27, after a similar Bar Council of India circular barring NALSAR Hyderabad's 2026 graduates from enrollment was retracted following backlash. The Jharkhand and Bihar exam-protest fronts remain unchanged since their Aug 17 and Aug 27 concessions.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
